=== CITUS DISTRIBUTION LEGEND ===

Green (#c8e6c9): Distributed by iq_tenant_id
  All patient queries are tenant-scoped.
  JOINs within a tenant hit one node.

All 7 tables are distributed — EMPI has no
reference tables (unlike Configurator).

=== TABLE ROLES ===

patients: Golden record (canonical identity)
patient_source_records: Provenance for merge
patient_identifiers: N-per-patient cross-refs
patient_addresses: Normalized address structs
sequence_counters: UHID generation
match_candidates: Future batch dedup (schema-only)
merge_history: Merge/unmerge audit trail

=== MVP vs FUTURE ===

MVP: patients, source_records, identifiers,
     addresses, sequence_counters
Future: match_candidates, merge_history
        (tables exist, logic deferred)
